stories.title: Major airline steps in to bring Pearland HS band home after Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
stories.summary: United Airlines is providing three planes to bring Pearland band members and chaperones home Saturday, where a community celebration is planned.

stories.title: Traffic stop leads to another arrest for man awaiting trial in Harris County mail theft case
stories.summary: A man awaiting trial in a previous mail theft case was arrested again after deputies allegedly found stolen mail, mailbox keys and a fake ID.

stories.title: New court documents reveal what happened the night a Harris County woman was allegedly killed by her boyfriend
stories.summary: Court documents reveal new details about the deadly shooting of Angel Posey as authorities continue searching for her boyfriend, Jaelon Henry-Mason.

stories.title: Driver killed after 18-wheeler rolls off 610 South Loop ramp near Highway 225
stories.summary: Houston police say an 18-wheeler driver died Friday after the truck rolled off the eastbound 610 South Loop ramp to Highway 225.

stories.title: Free family concert, activities and board game giveaways coming to Discovery Green Saturday
stories.summary: The Prelude Music Foundation and Discovery Green will host a free family concert Saturday featuring live music, kid-friendly activities and board game giveaways.

stories.title: Months after her death, 13-year-old Harris County foster child's case ruled a homicide
stories.summary: The medical examiner determined the 13-year-old girl died from environmental hyperthermia in the setting of neglect. No charges have been announced.

stories.title: Caught on camera: pint-sized porch pirate grabs package as crimes of this nature ramp up during the holidays
stories.summary: Ways to protect your purchases from porch pirates include using locker systems or having packages delivered to work or a trusted neighbor.

stories.title: Got Thanksgiving leftovers? Try this chef's loaded grilled sandwich
stories.summary: Houston-area chef Ben McPherson shares how to transform leftover turkey, ham, sweet potatoes and cranberry sauce into a hearty grilled sandwich.

stories.title: $5K reward offered for escaped pregnant New Mexico inmate with Houston-area ties
stories.summary: Authorities are offering up to $5,000 for tips on Rebecca Taylor, who drove away from a New Mexico prison transport and has ties to the Houston area.

stories.title: Girlfriend's body found in her abandoned car in NE Harris County, HCSO says | Investigators looking for boyfriend
stories.summary: "If you see him, DO NOT APPROACH," the sheriff said on social media. "Call 911 immediately."

stories.title: A truck driver and his mystery passenger died in 1991. Now, 35 years later, there's a breakthrough
stories.summary: The unidentified passenger was known as "Helen Doe" for decades before DNA testing revealed her name.

stories.title: Driver dies after crashing into retention pond in southwest Houston, officials say
stories.summary: Investigators are working to determine what led up to the deadly crash.
